CacheEvictor Artifact: androidx.media3:media3-datasource View Source Kotlin | Java @ UnstableApi public interface CacheEvictor extends Cache.Listener Known direct subclasses LeastRecentlyUsedCacheEvictor , NoOpCacheEvictor LeastRecentlyUsedCacheEvictor Evicts least recently used cache files first.
